evidence: Shared-state model: tests/test.sh:104-111 starts ONE app process on one DB_PATH; run_suite gates (line 213) then run_suite scored (line 224) both hit it, rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1, so render, constraints, then functional/polish/visual (order inside a suite not fixed by the task) all mutate the same database; only functional's D restarts it (restart_mcp.py single use, same DB). Each dimension is written state-relative: app_context.md:27-31 'every review can create its own job and cards ... Other reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages; never rely on a starting count.' functional/prompt.md:15 'Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol (suffix every title and name for this review), never move another review's records, and never rely on starting counts.' polish/prompt.md:14 'Use your own new job and cards ... never rely on another review's records' and 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own.' constraints gate creates a unique job/candidate and checks 'exactly one card for that candidate' (unique name). Relative counts: hro_unread_counts 'rises by exactly two', Mei Lin's count 'computed from the observed sequence'; hro_thread_latest/earlier grade 'most recent 30' and '30 at a time ... until none remain' (tolerates extra Noor messages from polish live_thread/failed_send); T fallback 'counts read relative to their values before you act'; T opens J3 'if that address is already on J2'; hro_activity is scoped to J1/J2 and 'filtering to one job'. The only pristine-seed reads are functional Z: Lena Fischer unread=1 on Product Designer (seed reads USR-CAN3/APP-301 read_count 2 of 3 messages -> 1) and the seeded Platform Engineer order Applied Greta, Ade, Marco / Screen Priya, Samuel plus Noor's note (seed APP-105/106/108, APP-103/104, note on APP-101), graded in hro_unread_counts and hro_restart. Every other dimension is fenced off from those exact values: render gate 'Do not create, move or send anything, and do not open any conversation'; constraints gate 'Do not move, reject or message anything here'; polish 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation' and uses only its own job/cards (its Noor-conversation steps add messages to APP-101, which no seed-value row counts absolutely); visual 'review read-only ... Do not move cards or send messages' (a seeded job may be viewed; staff viewing Lena's thread would not change Lena's own read marker). Within functional, Z is explicitly 'Before anything else' and 'Move nothing on that job'; later functional protocols never touch Platform Engineer cards or Lena, and D compares post-restart state with what Z read. Drafts in the golden are per-person localStorage (app.js:38-42) and each judge's Playwright runs --isolated, so drafts do not cross dimensions. Broken-app probe: an app that resets to seed on every request or on restart would still be caught (hro_restart 'starting data is not loaded again'; relative counts). Conforming-alternative probe: an app with server-side drafts (allowed by instruction.md:7, which only requires drafts to survive sign-out and stay private per person) is the one residual path: if polish ran before functional and its hro_pol_session_resume left Rafael's server-side reply draft in a conversation functional later uses for hro_drafts/hro_msg_compose (e.g. the Data Analyst fallback or the 'another conversation' draft), functional has no 'clear leftover draft' instruction like polish's, so typed text would be appended. The rows still largely hold (draft is kept with its conversation, box empties after send) so this is latent P3, not a mis-grade I can demonstrate. Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json scope says 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'; the scripted golden run is one driver, not a gates->scored multi-dimension judge sequence, so cross-dimension tolerance is not measured. Risk=true for that missing runtime evidence and the latent server-side-draft asymmetry.
counterexample: Latent only (not a demonstrated Fail): a conforming app that stores reply drafts server-side per user; rewardkit runs polish before functional; polish's session-resume leaves 'distinctive unsent reply' in, say, Tomas's Data Analyst conversation; functional falls back to that conversation in T and types its two-line message/draft on top of leftover text, with no instruction to clear it first.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening: add polish's sentence 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own' to functional/prompt.md T; obtain a full configured gates+scored run to measure cross-dimension tolerance.
